write_up: Your resume points toward Staff Accountant and Accounts Payable Specialist jobs. A recruiter can see both your current invoice work at Bayou Industrial Supply and your broader accounting responsibilities at Minh Phat Trading Company. That combination makes your experience easy to follow.

The Minh Phat closing line is a great model: it names the checklist and template you made and shows the close dropping from 12 days to 7 days. Your current role also names its invoice volume and QuickBooks, so a recruiter can picture the work.

Let's strengthen the month-end line at Bayou by naming the tasks you help the controller with. For each application, lead with the work closest to the job: general ledger and financial statements for Staff Accountant, or invoices and vendor reconciliation for Accounts Payable Specialist.
